name: Product Documentation & Support Content
description: Writing end-user product documentation, step-by-step how-to guides, administrative manuals, troubleshooting runbooks, changelogs, release notes, and customer support self-service knowledge bases.

subskills.name: How-To Guides & Procedural Documentation
subskills.description: Writing action-oriented, numbered procedural guides with prerequisite callouts, UI navigation paths, expected outcomes, and verification steps.

subskills.name: Release Notes & Changelog Authoring
subskills.description: Drafting release notes, changelog entries conforming to Keep a Changelog (Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security), and version announcements.

subskills.name: FAQ Articles & Support Self-Service Content
subskills.description: Authoring concise FAQ articles, knowledge base self-service answers, and deflecting repetitive customer support inquiries.

subskills.name: Troubleshooting & Root Cause Diagnostic Guides
subskills.description: Structuring diagnostic guides: symptoms, root cause explanation, step-by-step remediation, workarounds, and verification commands.

subskills.name: Admin Guides & Enterprise Configuration Manuals
subskills.description: Authoring enterprise administrator guides: SSO/SAML setup, role-based access control (RBAC), audit logging, network allowlisting, and system configurations.

subskills.name: In-Product Microcopy & Embedded Assistance
subskills.description: Writing UI microcopy, modal dialogues, tooltip text, empty states, error strings, and embedded in-app onboarding walkthroughs.

subskills.name: Support Ticket Deflection & KCS Strategy
subskills.description: Analyzing customer support ticket drivers, identifying top deflection opportunities, and structuring knowledge content to reduce MTTR and ticket volume.

subskills.name: Disaster Recovery & Operational Runbooks
subskills.description: Authoring operational runbooks, disaster recovery procedures, incident response playbooks, and high-severity escalation documentation.

subskills.name: User Feedback Loops & Documentation CSAT
subskills.description: Designing in-doc feedback mechanisms ('Was this helpful?'), analyzing CSAT/DSAT ratings, verbatim comments, and driving continuous document enhancement.

junior.description: Drafts step-by-step how-to articles, standard Keep a Changelog entries, and self-service FAQ answers.

mid.description: Writes diagnostic troubleshooting guides, enterprise admin configuration manuals, and in-product UI microcopy.
